name: sketchpad
description: Draw on an iPad. Your coding agent sees the page, answers, and draws back.
long_description: Sketchpad turns an iPad into a handwriting pad for any MCP agent. You draw with an Apple Pencil; the agent receives the page as an image, answers, and can draw back as editable strokes or hand over a rendered diagram as a movable layer.

tools.name: sketchpad_wait_for_turn
tools.description: Wait for the person to send a page from the iPad.

tools.name: sketchpad_show
tools.description: Reply, draw back, or hand over a rendered image.
